title: Untitled (Three Discs, Wide)
description: Collaged elements across a horizontal white ground include three Discraft compact discs positioned at varying heights, a row of concentric bullseye targets along the lower register, and geometric cutouts in cyan, orange, and red triangles at right. Photographic fragments depicting a football, chess pawn, and stacked discs occupy the left and lower margins.
